γιγνώσκω: to learn to know, to perceive, mark, learn
διαφεύγω: to flee through, get away from, escape
διόλλυμι: to destroy utterly, bring to naught
θάλλω: to bloom, abound, to be luxuriant
καταλαμβάνω: to seize upon, lay hold of
κεύθω: to cover quite up, to cover, hide
κομίζω: to take care of, provide for
λάσκω: to ring, rattle; to scream, shout
λαγχάνω: to obtain by lot, by fate, by the will of the gods
λανθάνω: to escape notice, to be unknown, unseen, unnoticed
μέλω: to be an object of care
μέμαα: to wish eagerly, strive, yearn, desire
μέμονα: to wish eagerly, to yearn, strive, be fain
μεθίστημι: to place in another way, to change
μετέχω: to partake of, enjoy a share of, share in, take part in
μεταβάλλω: to throw into a different position, to turn quickly
μεταβαίνω: to pass over from one place to another
νομίζω: to have as a custom; to believe
οἴχομαι: to be gone, to have gone
παρηβάω: to be past one’s prime, to be growing old
πείθω: to prevail upon, win over, persuade
περάω: to drive right through; pass, penetrate
περιτρέχω: to run round and round, run round
πονέω: to work hard, do work, suffer toil
προλείπω: to go forth and leave, to leave behind, forsake, abandon
συμβάλλω: to throw together; come together; collect, contract, contribute
συνίστημι: to set together, combine, associate, unite, band together
συντήκω: to fuse into one mass, to weld together
τρέφω: to nourish, rear, maintain; congeal, curdle
τυγχάνω: (with gen.) to hit the mark, to get; (with pple) to happen to, to actually
φαίνω: to bring to light, make to appear
φεύγω: to flee, take flight, run away
φύω: to bring forth, produce, put forth
χωρέω: give way, draw back, retire, withdraw
ἀνίστημι: to make to stand up, raise up
ἀναβαίνω: to go up, mount, to go up to
ἀναφαίνω: to make to give light, make to blaze up
ἁλίσκομαι: to be caught, conquered, caught in the act
ἄρχω: (to be first) to rule, to begin
ἐκγίγνομαι: to be born of; impers. supplementing ἔξεστι, it is allowed, granted
ἐκλείπω: to leave out, omit, pass over
ἐξίστημι: to put out of its place, to change
ἐπακολουθέω: to follow close upon, follow after
ἐφίστημι: to set on, over; set in charge of
ἔοικα: to be like; to look like
ἔχω: have, hold; be able; (+ adv.) be; (mid.) cling to, be next to (+ gen.)
ὁμολογέω: agree, say the same thing as
ὄλλυμι: to destroy, make an end of
ὑπεραίρω: to lift or raise up over; (intr.) to excel, exceed
ὑπολαμβάνω: take up; understand, interpret; assume; reply, rejoin
